bphs-97:santhanam:ch18:v35-39.exact_text: 35-39. TIMING OF WIFE’S DEATH. Loss of wife will occur in the 18<sup>th</sup> year, or 33<sup>rd</sup> year of age of the native, if Yuvati Lord is in fall, while Shukra is in Randhr. One will lose his spouse in his 19<sup>th</sup> year, if Yuvati Lord is in the 8<sup>th</sup> , while Vyaya Lord is in Yuvati. The native’s wife will die within three days of marriage due to snake bite, if the native has Rahu in Dhan and Mangal in Yuvati. If Shukra is in Randhr, while his dispositor is in a Rashiof Shani, death of wife will take place during the native’s 12<sup>th</sup> , or 21<sup>st</sup> year of age. Should the ascendat Lord be in his Rashiof debilitation, as Dhan Lord is in Randhr, loss of wife will occur in the 13<sup>th</sup> year of age.
